Previously this returned an unfilterable, unpaginated slice, so an operator could not answer
"which invoices were rejected?" without reading the whole list themselves.

One invoice's compliance detail — status, warnings, ZATCA errors, the message, the retry

to resubmit from WHY it was rejected. Omits the heavy signed/cleared XML. Tenant-guarded — a
platform operator sees any invoice; a tenant admin only its own, and one it may not see is 404.

filling the same number so the chain stays gapless. Refused for an already-signed invoice.

post.description:
Abandon a stuck reserved ICV so the number is REUSED — only when it is the tenant's highest
reserved ICV and unsigned. Refused (422) when a higher ICV exists: a mid-chain number cannot be
skipped; correct-and-resign it or issue a cancellation document instead. Never releases a signed
invoice.

Which credentials are set, and a four-character hint for each.

There is no value in this response and no route that would return one. The hint exists so an
operator can tell which key is loaded before replacing it — replacing the wrong one is the
mistake this prevents.

is overwritten by the action itself, so an unrecorded rotation is unreconstructable.

post.description:
Restore an archive this service produced. Idempotent; leaves newer rows alone by default.

After the invoices are restored, the ICV chain head and number index are rebuilt from them — a
restore that skipped them would let the next invoice re-issue an ICV that already exists, which
is a ZATCA compliance defect, not a glitch.

post.description:
zatca deletes NO legal record — it CANNOT, and the ack says why.

A signed invoice carries a ZATCA signature over its own bytes and its hash is the next
invoice's PIH, so altering one invoice would invalidate every invoice after it. Unlike billing,
the buyer's identity here cannot even be pseudonymised. What IS erased is the unsigned draft
working copy of already-accepted invoices: real personal data, no legal significance.

schema.title: Response Erase Subject Internal Privacy Erase Post

post.description:
E-invoice one invoice (any service calls this after settling). Never fails the
caller — a transient error leaves the invoice retryable ('pending').

schema.title: Response Finalize Internal Zatca Finalize Post

get.description:
Stuck-tail observability: the gap between the RESERVED and contiguously-SIGNED ICV heads for
a tenant, plus a `stuck` flag when it exceeds ZATCA_STUCK_TAIL_THRESHOLD. A permanently-stuck
ICV defers every later one, so a growing lag is the earliest symptom — this is what a monitor
polls to alert before a whole day of valid invoices piles up behind one bad predecessor.
